Agnico Eagle Mines LTD (AEM) Holder Stack Financial Management Decreased Stake; As Medtronic Plc (MDT) Market Value Declined, Shareholder Marco Investment Management Has Increased Its Stake 
April 22, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Marco Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Medtronic Plc (MDT) by 5.59% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Marco Investment Management Llc bought 10,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 190,656 shares of the electromedical & electrotherapeutic apparatus company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.40M, up from 180,556 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Marco Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Medtronic Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $108.29B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.12% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $79.9. About 3.69 million shares traded. Medtronic plc (NYSE:MDT) has declined 3.54% since April 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.09% the S&P500. 
Stack Financial Management Inc decreased its stake in Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd. (AEM) by 2.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stack Financial Management Inc sold 7,120 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.52% with the market. The institutional investor held 318,820 shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.72M, down from 325,940 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stack Financial Management Inc who had been investing in Agnico Eagle Mines Ltd. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $10.19 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $0.23 during the last trading session, reaching $44.16. About 1.01 million shares traded. Agnico Eagle Mines Limited (NYSE:AEM) has declined 6.12% since April 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.67% the S&P500.

As per Tuesday, October 10, the company rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Tuesday, September 29 by RBC Capital Markets. The firm has “Hold” rating by Stifel Nicolaus given on Wednesday, November 23. On Friday, November 13 the stock rating was upgraded by Goldman Sachs to “Conviction Buy List”. The stock of Medtronic plc (NYSE:MDT) earned “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Monday, February 5. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, June 26 by Oppenheimer. The firm has “Hold” rating by Stifel Nicolaus given on Thursday, May 25. The stock has “Buy” rating by Needham on Wednesday, November 23. The company was maintained on Wednesday, August 23 by Jefferies.

It also reduced its holding in Home Depot Inc (NYSE:HD) by 3,312 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 70,325 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
